Title: Habitat
Note: Flat, firm ground north of the boxwork; Curiosity parked here on sol 4541.

Title: Ridge stop
Note: Boxwork ridge crest: cemented ridge rock where groundwater once flowed through fractures.

Title: Monte Grande hollow
Note: Hollow between ridges; Curiosity drilled 'Valle de la Luna' here (sol 4693).

Title: Nevado Sajama ridge
Note: Ridge beside the hollow; Curiosity drilled 'Nevado Sajama' here (sol 4718). Pair it with the hollow sample.

Title: South boxwork margin
Note: Where the boxwork network fades; sample the edge to bracket how far the groundwater reached.
